name: signalk-tablet-camera-timelapse
description: Timelapse photos from the tablet camera, as a native Freeboard-SK extension and a KIP-embeddable page. Frames are stored on the Signal K server and uploaded to Google Drive in the background.

scripts.lint: node --check index.js && for f in src/*.js src/drive/*.js public/js/auto.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && for f in public/js/core/*.js public/js/hosts/*.js; do node --input-type=module --check < $f || { echo "syntax error in $f"; exit 1; }; done

author: Zack Phillips
